Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE DETECTIVE BRANCH）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 160
Date 10/3/25
March 10th 1925.

Sir,
General Fong Nan Woo 方咸五 had all the soldiers at
the Arsenal paraded before him yesterday, when he called
the roll himself. The General chatted with several
soldiers about their families etc. Military Governor
Yang and Deputy Governor Lu were present during the
inspection, the latter having come from Woosung
especially for the purpose.
Four special detectives arrived at the Arsenal from
Peking the day before yesterday in order to make enquiries
regarding one of Yuan Shih Kai's military advisors named
Yih Tsing Hsi 葉景禧 who absconded some two weeks ago
from Peking and who is suspected of being implicated
in the plot to murder Yuan.
It is reported that a new secret society has sprung
into existence in Pootung called Thih Hyoeh Nyien Yah
Doo 铁血救国团 The leader of the society is named
Loong and he is busily engaged enrolling ex-soldiers
and unemployed workmen in the society. The reported
existence of this society has been brought to the
notice of General Yang, who has sent an officer and
four detectives to investigate the matter. He has
also instructed the police of the district concerned
to take precautions.
The Shanghai rebels have sent one of their number
named Hyang Hai Zien 向海潜 to Hangchow to interview
the Governor of Chekiang.

Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent.

上海工部局。
（印章：上海工部局警务处侦探股）
警务处，
（侦探股）
刑事侦缉处。
I. O. REG
第 160 号
日期 25年3月10日
1925年3月10日。

先生，
方咸五将军昨日在兵工厂召集全体士兵列队，并亲自点名。方将军与数名士兵闲谈，问及他们的家庭等情况。杨督军和卢副督军在视察期间在场，后者是特地从吴淞赶来的。
前天，四名特别侦探从北京抵达兵工厂，旨在调查袁世凯的一名军事顾问叶景禧（Yih Tsing Hsi）。此人约两周前从北京潜逃，涉嫌卷入谋杀袁世凯的阴谋。
据报，浦东出现了一个名为“铁血救国团”（Thih Hyoeh Nyien Yah Doo）的新秘密社团。该社团首领姓龙（Loong），他正忙于招募退伍士兵和失业工人加入社团。该社团存在的消息已引起杨将军的注意，他已派遣一名军官和四名侦探调查此事。他还指示相关地区的警察采取预防措施。
上海反叛者派出其中一名名叫向海潜（Hyang Hai Zien）的成员前往杭州，会见浙江省省长。

您顺从的仆人，
总探长。

警司。
